name: Combo Chart
description: Bars in tubes on the left axis and a line with dots on the right axis, in a card.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per column.

props.name: bars
props.description: Values for the bars, read on the left axis.

props.name: line
props.description: Values for the line, read on the right axis. The right axis is stepped to share the left axis's grid lines.

props.name: barName
props.description: What the bars count, for the legend and tooltip.

props.name: lineName
props.description: What the line measures, for the legend and tooltip.

props.name: barColor
props.description: Bar colour, seafoam by default.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Line colour, water by default.

props.name: formatBar
props.description: Writes bar values in the tooltip. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatLine
props.description: Writes line values in the tooltip. Defaults to a percentage of a fraction.

props.name: formatBarAxis
props.description: Writes the left tick labels. Defaults to compact numbers.

props.name: formatLineAxis
props.description: Writes the right tick labels. Defaults to percentages.

props.name: lineAxisClassName
props.description: Classes for the right tick labels, so they read in the line's colour.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels.

props.name: titles
props.description: Longer names for the tooltip title.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend naming the bars and the line.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the left-hand axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yRightLabel
props.description: A title beside the right-hand axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline number, already formatted.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: note
props.description: A muted line under the value.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts caption, action, footer, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
